main.description: Crawl one or more Japanese statutes from the e-Gov 法令 API v2 and write statute / article records to Hyperdrive. Idempotent: existing (jurisdiction, statuteId) is updated; existing (articleDid) rows are skipped.

lawId.description: e-Gov lawId (e.g. '325AC0000000131' for 民法). Mutually exclusive with `since`.

since.description: ISO 8601 date — fetch all statutes updated after this cutoff.

limit.description: Max statutes to ingest in one call (default 10, max 200). Applies to `since` mode only.
